SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Are you listening to me, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Oh, of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san, that was really mean of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? What was?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You know what I mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I was waiting here all alone, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry.

[FI] Yeah, I did leave her behind. And as a result, she 
had to wait by herself, all alone...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Do you really regret it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I do. I won't leave you behind again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Can I really trust you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...But Kanako was still here with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] You know her. Did you really think she would 
obediently stay put if she saw a chance to escape?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I didn't think you would let her...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] And just what do you mean by that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, well... You know, just a figure of speech...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Oh, well. It's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, I even went and bought a new swimsuit...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Speaking of which, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That swimsuit looks great on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Wha-- ...W-Where did that come from?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] W-What was I supposed to do? I didn't get the 
chance to say it earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That might be so, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Does it really look good on me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, it's undeniably cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hm? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-It's nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um, Ayase-san, why do you seem so angry?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Put your hand over your heart and think about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even if you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=17]...Geez, you're so dense.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] But in the end, you just had to chase after Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, you never know what she's up to, so I went 
after her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...So, you abandoned me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I was just like, going with the flow...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] If...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] If I had started running the other way, would you 
have chased after me instead?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Of course. I would have definitely come chasing 
after you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Even if that meant ignoring Kirino?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, after I've caught up with you, I might go 
after her again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...I really don't know. I can't decide that before I'm 
actually in that situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, I'll just have to come along with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Thanks, that's reassuring.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Let's worry about Kirino later. Why don't we go 
have some fun now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah. We're at the beach, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, right. Before that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see how it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I knew it. Onii-san, Kirino still comes first to you...
